name: startap-launch-kit
description: Get a website ready to launch: audit and fix its SEO, social previews and AI-search access in the code, check the live site and its Domain Rating, plan free startup directory submissions, and keep a dated launch checklist.

interface.longDescription: Four skills for getting a website ready to launch. launch-audit checks page templates for titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemaps and AI-crawler access, then fixes what's missing. site-check grades a live site's SEO, AI-search readiness and sitemap through the StarTap API, with a curl fallback for local and private sites. directory-submissions builds a submission plan from StarTap's curated list of startup directories and writes ready-to-paste listing copy. launch-checklist writes a dated launch plan into the repo and ticks off what the code already proves is done. site-check sends the address being checked to startap.cc; the other skills only download StarTap's public lists.
defaultPrompt: Check my live site for SEO and AI search
Where should I list my startup?
